pick.summary:
The honest pick is 12% dip, 2 coins with 50% of the account each, +5% take-profit, 48h time stop, 24h cooldown. Chosen on 2021-23 only, it made +5.53%/month in 2024-26 (x6.12) against +2.89% for the live settings. Its worst drop was -29% against -16%, and its worst month -21% against -6%.

This does not give a reliable 5-10%/month, for five reasons:
(1) The whole 5.5% average comes from 2024 (+10.9%/month). Since Jan 2025 it made +2.66%/month with a -28.6% drop; the live settings made +1.96% with -15.5%.
(2) It falls below 5% under realistic conditions: fills 0.2% worse 4.97%, all stresses together 4.80%, stricter 1-minute fills 4.17-4.25%, and depth 12.1% instead of 12% gives 4.76%.
(3) The rule only reaches 5% because of where the drop limit sits. The pick's 2021-23 drop was -49.6%, right at the -50% limit. With a -45% limit the rule picks a setting that made 4.00%/month. Of the rule's top 10, only 3 made 5%.
(4) The worst case is deep. The 2021-23 drop was -50%; adding LUNA/FTT/SRM makes it -62%, with 2022 at -28%. The 2018-20 holdout was not touched. The live settings lost 45% in the March 2020 crash, and this setting puts half the account into each of two coins.
(5) Choosing honestly on 2021-23 by smallest drop missed every target from 3% to 7% (it got 1.95-3.76%/month). Only 12% of settings that made 5%/month in 2021-23 also did in 2024-26. Even with hindsight, 5%/month needed at least a -26% drop and 7% needed -49%. 10%/month was never reached by any setting.

Recommendation: do not fund this with credit-card money. On borrowed money, a -30% to -60% drop is a loss of money that is owed, and in 2024-26 about 28% of 30-day periods ended down. Interest on unpaid card debt is riba, which conflicts with the bot's own Shariah rules. If the user still wants more return, this pick is the one honest candidate. Plan for about 2.5-5%/month and drops of -30% to -60%, run it only with the user's own spare money, and treat the live settings (about 2-3%/month, -16%) as the safer baseline.

No existing files were edited and nothing was committed.

Stress rows:

- **Strict 1-minute fills:** r2_realism_lib.rrun with beps 0.3%, seps 0.2%, lat 1, mpx 1 (round-2 row (g)). This reproduces LIVE 2024-26 x2.31, as REFINE.md states.

- **+LUNA/FTT/SRM:** hourly engine, 22 coins.
- **Worst combined (extra):** strict fills + bot timing + LUNA/FTT/SRM in the 1-minute engine.
- **Jitter band:** depth -0.1/+0.1 point (14.9/15.1% for F) plus start +1..7 days, 9 runs. Uses the r3_noise method: 2021-23 runs start at 2021-01-01+d; 2024-26 runs start fresh at 2024-01-01+d.
- **Extra band:** 30 fresh 2024 starts, d = 0..29.

%/month = mult^(1/months) - 1, with 36 months (2021-23) and 33.7 months (2024-26), less d/30.44 months for start shifts.

The 1-minute panel was loaded once (22 coins, 4.2 GB peak).

Data fix in my own script, not in the existing files: minute_panel fills collapse-coin minutes flat up to the cut. That let the 1-minute engine trade FTT during its 10-month halt and buy LUNA after its last real trade (13 May 2022 00:39). It also left A and F stuck in phantom positions. Those minutes are now blanked, which matches how the corrected hourly engine treats them.
stress.summary:
Verdict: none of these settings gives a safe 5% a month, and the ones that reach it are not fit for credit-card money.

1. **Putting everything in one coin can wipe the account.** A, B and F (N=1, 100% of the money per trade) look like the best performers, but each loses 99.6% to 100% of the account in May 2022 once LUNA/FTT/SRM are in the coin list.
   - A lost everything in one LUNA trade (x41 down to x0.007).
   - B ended up with all its money stuck in LUNA when trading stopped.
   - F went from x108.8 to x0.44 in one trade.
   - The 19 live coins look safe only because they were picked in 2026, after they survived. Any of them can be the next LUNA, and the live bot has no delisting or halt guard.
   - Even without collapse coins, A has had single trades lose 21.7% to 41.6% of the whole account and a 29.5% loss in one day (10 Oct 2025).

2. **With realistic fills, about 5% a month barely survives, and only for the riskiest settings.** With strict 1-minute fills plus real bot timing, 2024-26 comes to:
   - A +5.2% (drop -50%), B +6.0% (-33%), F +5.4% (-32%)
   - C +5.0% (-30%), D +4.6% (-28%), E +4.1% (-32%), G +4.2% (-30%)
   - LIVE +2.5% (-18%)

   With every fill 0.2% worse, the range is +4.4% to +6.2%. 10% a month does not appear anywhere outside the hindsight 2021 boom.

3. **The results are not a lucky start date or depth.** All 30 fresh starts in January 2024 stay at 5% a month or more for A to G under normal fills, and the jitter bands are only 0.2 to 0.7 points wide in 2024-26. This does not remove the bigger biases:
   - These settings are the top 3% of 960, chosen by their 2024-26 results on the same data.
   - The coin list itself was chosen with survivorship bias.

4. **The least bad way to reach about 5% is C** (N=2, 50% per order, tp 3%, 48h). It survives the collapse coins (2021-23 drop -65%) and gives 4.8% to 6.7% a month in 2024-26 across all stresses, with drops of -29% to -31%.
   - Expect roughly 4.5% to 5% a month with real fills.
   - Expect a 50% to 65% drop in a 2021/2022-style crash, worst single days of about -33%, and single trades costing 20% to 35% of the account.
   - G (N=3) is steadier but realistically gives about 4.1% to 4.4% a month.

5. **Credit-card money.** On RM6,000, C's 2021-23 drops mean RM3,000 to RM3,900 gone while the card balance stays the same. A or B can go to zero. Card interest charges would also break the user's no-interest rule.

The live settings remain the only ones tested here with drops under 20% in 2024-26.

ruin.method:
New script /home/user/halal-rider/research/panic_buyer/refine/hr_ruin.py. No existing files were edited and nothing was committed. It runs in 14 s on one core. Outputs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-halal-rider/ec562e35-ea9e-5a74-ab92-4ff22c5eeb77/scratchpad/pb_out_hr/ruin/: hr_ruin.log, hr_ruin_bootstrap.csv (every pool, variant and setting), hr_ruin_actual_windows.csv and hr_ruin_seed_noise.csv.

1. engine.run on the 19-coin hourly panel (study.market(False)) for five settings, all at depth 12% and cooldown 24h:
   - LIVE: N=8, fmax 0.20, tp 1.5%, 48h
   - A: N=1, fmax 1.0, tp 3%, 48h
   - C: N=2, fmax 0.5, tp 3%, 48h
   - E: N=2, fmax 0.5, tp 5%, 48h
   - G: N=3, fmax 0.33, tp 3%, 48h

   Each run is self-checked against grid960_19coins.csv, and all five reproduce it (LIVE x5.75/x2.61, A x361.85/x9.78, C x79.74/x7.85, E x89.88/x6.12, G x30.08/x5.98). The engine is unchanged, so only information known at each hour's start is used.
2. Daily returns are close to close of the hourly equity at each UTC day's last hour, starting from 1.0. The partial last day (2026-10-22) is dropped. That leaves 2,120 days from 2021-01-01 to 2026-10-21.
3. Pools of daily returns:
   - The two the task asked for: 2021-26 (2,120 days) and 2022-23 (730 days).
   - Two extras for context: 2024-26 only (1,025 days) and 2022 only (365 days).
4. Circular block bootstrap: 13 blocks of 30 consecutive days, each starting at a random day and wrapping past the pool's end, cut to 365 days. 10,000 paths. Every setting uses the same block draws (one seed per pool), so all settings face the same simulated markets.
5. Per path:
   - 12-month result = product of (1 + r) minus 1.
   - Worst drop = deepest fall of the daily equity below its running peak, counting from the start.
   - Lowest balance = lowest daily close compared with the RM6,000 put in.
   - "Average of 5% a month or more" means a 12-month result of at least 1.05^12 - 1 = +79.6%. The 10% a month bar is +213.8%.
6. Sensitivities on the same pools:
   - +LUNA/FTT/SRM: the 22-coin panel, with the collapse coins cut as in engine.DEAD.
   - Real bot timing: mtp_now=True, cd=25.
7. Check without resampling: every real 365-day window inside each pool.
8. Monte Carlo noise: a second seed changes probabilities by at most 1.9 points, the 5th percentile by at most 3.5 points and the median by at most 7.4 points.
ruin.summary:
Bottom line: in this bootstrap, getting 5% a month means accepting a 30-79% chance of a drop of more than 30% within the year. For A (all money in one coin), the realistic worst case is losing the whole RM6,000.

1. **What the 5% a month costs.** On the 19 surviving coins, 2021-26 pool, the four concentrated settings have a 76-85% chance of averaging 5% a month over 12 months. The live settings have 26.1%.
   - Chance of a drop of more than 30% within the year: A 78.7%, E 44.6%, C 39.6%, G 30.0%, live 0.4%.
   - Chance of a drop of more than 50%: A 17.5%; the others 0.5-1.8%.
   - Chance the balance falls below RM4,200 at some point: A 19.2%, C 4.3%, E 5.0%, G 1.9%.

2. **In the 2022-23 bear-market pool, A is a gamble.**
   - A: 15.4% chance of a losing year, 36.8% chance of a drop of more than 50%, 42.7% chance the balance goes below RM4,200. 5th percentile RM4,052.
   - C and G: 5th percentile about break-even (RM5,981 and RM6,032).
   - E did best in this pool (5th percentile RM7,093, P(loss) 1.9%) but worst of C, E and G in the 2024-26 pool (5th percentile +0.2%). The ranking flips between pools, so the differences between C, E and G are not reliable.

3. **Survivorship is the biggest risk.** The 19 coins are survivors. Adding back LUNA, FTT and SRM, coins a buy-the-dip bot would have traded at the time, changes the picture for the concentrated settings:
   - A, 2021-26 pool: 22.6% chance of a losing year, 47.6% chance of a drop of more than 50%, 5th percentile RM1. The account is effectively wiped out because LUNA took 100% of the equity.
   - 2022-23 pool: A median -44.0% (RM3,358) with a 67.8% chance of losing. C: P(loss) 28.1%, 5th percentile RM2,899. E: 20.6%, RM3,394. G: 22.5%, RM4,000. Live: 20.0%, RM5,214.
   - 2022 alone: C, E and G have medians of -17% to -25% and a 64-66% chance of a losing year.

   A future LUNA-type collapse in a coin the bot holds is the realistic ruin case, and N=1 with fmax 1.0 has no protection against it.

4. **These numbers are optimistic. The bootstrap cannot remove these biases:**
   - The four settings were chosen from 960 because they did well in 2024-26, and the bootstrap resamples those same days.
   - The 2021-26 pool contains the 2021 mania year (A made x361.85 in 2021-23).
   - Daily closes hide drops inside a day; hourly drops are deeper (A 2024-26: -49% hourly vs -46.6% daily).
   - 30-day blocks under-represent bear markets that last many months.
   - Fills here are the engine's normal fills. With strict fills, an earlier stress test cut A's 2024-26 result from x9.78 to x5.60.
   - The 2020 COVID-style crash (-45% for the live settings per REFINE.md) is not in these pools.

   Without any resampling, A lost money in 26.3% of the real 365-day windows starting in 2024-26.

5. **Card cost.** Assuming an 18%/year card rate (an assumption, not data), the chance a year earns less than the interest in the 2022-23 pool is:
   - 19 coins: live 33.7%, A 22.8%, C 10.9%, E 5.0%, G 11.4%.
   - With LUNA/FTT/SRM: live 59.0%, A 73.8%, C 37.4%, E 28.7%, G 35.8%.

6. **Live settings:** a median of +55.4% (2021-26 pool) or +25.9% (2022-23 pool), 26.1% chance of 5% a month, almost no chance of a drop of more than 30%. Their weak spot is a bear year: 18.2% chance of a loss in the 2022-only pool, 46.2% with LUNA/FTT/SRM.

**Verdict:** no setting tested gives 5% a month without a real chance of losing a large part of borrowed money. A should not be funded with credit-card money. If the user insists on more return, G (N=3) had the smallest drops of the aggressive settings, but it still has a 22.5% chance of a losing year in a 2022-23-type market with collapses.

verify.reasons:
The pick (12% dip, N=2, fmax 0.5, take-profit +5%, 48h time stop, 24h cooldown) is not a sound way to get 5%/month. The numbers reproduce exactly, and the selection code saw only 2021-23 columns. But the 5% result fails when the real bot code is run, sits on a filter edge that was set after the 2024-26 numbers were known, and rests on 2024 and on one or two coins. The task's default rule ("refuted if it fails under real-bot timing") is triggered.

1. The pre-registration is genuine but did not protect anything. The file hash matches (sha256 74c393bc...e109), and its timestamp (06:52:11) is before the stamp (06:52:24) and before the outputs (from 06:52:47). However, results/grid960_19coins.csv was written at 05:37, 75 minutes earlier. It already held this exact setting (d12 N2 f0.5/1.0 tp5 hm48 cd24) and its 2024-26 result of x6.1177. The task brief itself cites that file. Applying the "pre-registered" rule to that file picks the same setting first. So the "one look at 2024-26" was not a first look. The rule's knobs were set by someone who could see 2024-26 for all 960 settings: a -50% drop limit (earlier rounds used -35% and "no deeper drop than live"), 2022 >= 0%, and highest CAGR. Under the earlier rounds' own rule (engine.pick_on_design), nothing on this grid qualifies. The pick's 2021-23 drop of -49.60% is 0.40 points inside the -50% limit. With a -45% limit the rule picks a setting that made 4.00%/month.

2. It fails with the real bot code. I replayed the unmodified panic_buyer.py through tests/fake_binance.py with the pick's settings over 2024-01..2026-10 on 18 coins (RENDER drops out because the replay does not join RNDR to RENDER): x4.960 = +4.87%/month, worst drop -28.8%. The engine with bot timing on the same coins gives x4.952 (+4.87%). A 2021-26 replay on 16 coins gives 2024-26 x4.42 = +4.51%/month, against the engine's +4.90%. Using the bot-timing model, which the replay confirms, on all 19 coins gives +5.38%/month. But removing RENDER alone gives +4.87% and removing DOGE alone gives +4.93%. So under real timing the 5% depends on single coins.

3. Trade and period concentration. Not one or two trades: the top trade is 3.1% of log growth and the top 5 are 8.2%. The top 5 trades by dollar P&L are 13.6% of net P&L, but that is distorted by compounding. Removing the top 5 trades leaves: backtest +5.05%/month, bot timing +4.91%, real-code replay +4.40%. Removing the top 10 leaves 4.68%, 4.54% and 4.04%. The result is concentrated in time: 2024 is 68% of the log growth. Without the single best month (Nov 2024, +49.3%) it is +4.28%/month; without the best two (Nov 2024 and Mar 2024, +42.3%) it is +3.19%. The median month is +4.27%.

4. Against the live settings, year by year (engine backtest, pick vs live):

| Period | Pick | Live |
|---|---|---|
| 2024 | +247% | +71% |
| 2025 | +37% | +28% |
| 2026 to date | +29% | +19% |
| Since Jan 2025 | +2.66%/month, drop -29% | +1.96%/month, drop -15% |

Since Jan 2025 in the real-code replay (same 18 coins): +2.47%/month (drop -29%) vs +1.96%/month (drop -15%). With stricter 1-minute fills since Jan 2025, the pick does worse than live: +1.22%/month (drop -34%) vs +1.65%/month (drop -15%). Over 2024-26 in the real-code replay: x4.96 vs x2.49.

5. The honest choice is fragile. The same rule, given more realistic 2021-23 data, picks other settings that miss 5% in 2024-26:

| 2021-23 data used for selection | Rule picks | 2024-26 %/month |
|---|---|---|
| With LUNA/FTT/SRM | d12 N2 tp2 cd12 | +4.91% |
| Simulated with bot timing | d12 N2 tp2 hm96 cd12 | +4.47% |
| All three stresses | d12 N2 tp1.5 hm96 | +4.17% |

With LUNA/FTT/SRM the pick fails its own filter: drop -62%, 2022 -28%.
